data.one_liner: Provides physics-based hover effects and tooltips for Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: Smooth_hover provides widgets and scopes to add physics-based hover animations, custom ink effects, and tooltips to user interfaces. It manages focus, press states, and mouse cursor behavior for desktop and web applications.
use_when: You want smooth, physics-based hover effects on desktop or web apps
You need customizable ink decorations and integrated tooltips on hoverable widgets
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-first app without desktop or web interactions
You only need standard Material tooltips without custom hover motion
strengths: Configurable ink effects and smart tooltips
Built-in focus and press state handling
weaknesses: Limited to hover states which are primarily relevant for desktop and web
